event.dorian_heart2.1.text: A fox. By the fern. Don't move. She's listening too. Not to us.
event.dorian_heart2.1.why: frightened: the fox attends to something else; the player is not the thing being judged

event.dorian_heart2.1.text: A fox. By the fern. Don't move. She keeps facing the wood.
event.dorian_heart2.1.why: uneasy: animals face the wood (ladder), told as plain observation

event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Further in. Not yet. Never after dark.
event.dorian_heart2.4.why: clue at full: the too-exact rule attached to the deeper place

event.dorian_heart2.4.text: There's another place. Further in. Not yet. Not on a new moon.
event.dorian_heart2.4.why: hint: an odd custom tied to the moon; a night the player can stay awake for

adds.text: ...She's gone. Toward the wood. Stand close. Like a tree.
adds.why: replaces the cut 'she stayed' beat: the fox leaves the way everything leaves now; Dorian gets gentler

adds.text: ...You stand the way he did. Don't. Please.
adds.why: frightened: Dorian sees Edmund in the player and cannot bear it; protective, not sinister

adds.text: Most say good morning. A few say stay in tonight.
adds.why: hint: the anonymous notes double as warnings on certain nights; a curious player can go read them

cuts.why: the fox does not stay for a frightened player; the add after .1 fills the beat
